description: Number of business days between two dates (start counted, end not counted, like numpy.busday_count), with the non-business days in between and why. calendars: one or more calendar codes from list_calendars, e.g. ["USD.FX", "EUR.FX"] for a EUR/USD FX trade, ["XNYS.SETTLE"] for NYSE settlement, ["TARGET2.PAY"] for euro payments, ["GBLON.BANK"] for London banks. A date counts as a business day only when it is open in every calendar given.
name: business_days_between
title: Business days between two dates
